species.real: The ridge path along the top of Sliabh Liag is called One Man's Pass, a narrow spine of rock with a long drop on either side. Many walkers decide the view from the car park is lovely too.
species.name: Liagling

dex.text: Breaks off a cliff edge in a storm and rolls about pretending to be an ordinary stone. It wears a tuft of sea pinks so the gulls know it is somebody.
dex.fact: The sea cliffs of Slieve League (Sliabh Liag) in south-west Donegal rise to about 600 metres, among the highest sea cliffs in Europe.

species.real: In the Second World War Ireland was neutral, and huge ÉIRE signs were laid out in white stones along its coast, including at Malin Head, to tell aircrews where they were.
species.name: Liagmor

dex.text: Its name is Irish for 'great stone'. It stands on the cliff edge in the worst weather, crackling with static, and lets the Atlantic break itself on its shins.
dex.fact: Malin Head in Donegal is the most northerly point of the island of Ireland, and Malin is one of the sea areas read out in the Shipping Forecast.
